findings.description: Directory paging: the unparameterized filtered URL (page 0) returned 10 cards, page=1 returned 10 different cards, page=2 returned 8 cards, and page=3 returned zero cards. Total 28 cards, all with unique names, matching the 28 directory-listed people in the brief. The unparameterized URL is not a duplicate of page=1. Source: iit-dir-base, iit-dir-page1, iit-dir-page2, iit-dir-page3.

Name cross-check: all 28 names on the three directory pages match brief.people exactly. No omissions: no person appears on the listing and is missing from the brief, and no brief person (other than Anna Barnett, per owner determination) is absent from the listing.

Only one directory profile page (Mohammad Shahidehpour) was fetched as optional evidence; the other listed people' titles come from the listing cards, which are official university pages. Their profile pages were not fetched.

Anna Barnett directory profile (https://www.iit.edu/directory/people/anna-barnett) returned HTTP 403 to an automated request, retrieved 2026-11-25; she is not on the ECE-filtered directory. This is an info note, not an omission.

Owner determination 2026-11-25 applied: primary ECE endowed chair stays regular. The listing card has no rank text, but the official profile (iit-profile-shahidehpour) states University Distinguished Professor and Galvin Chair Professor in ECE. "Affiliate Professor, Stuart School of Business" is secondary and does not make him affiliate_professor. Would change to excluded only if an official page stated he is not a professor in ECE.

Owner determination 2026-11-25 applied: Anna Barnett is regular / ece / current per the official IIT news page iit-news-barnett (ECE department chair, professor of electrical and computer engineering, endowed Motorola Professor of ECE, dated 16 Aug 2024).
